name: Isaac
headline: Turn Leonardo’s booking data into repeat stays.
saw: Your homepage sells direct online bookings across over 330 hotels, with 10% off for AdvantageCLUB members, and shows every visitor the same offer, whether they plan a stay in Berlin or a meeting in London.

Once a guest has stayed with you, where they return and which destinations they never try is your strongest signal for the next stay and for a guest about to lapse. Today that signal sits in reporting, not in the offer they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns for the AdvantageCLUB base are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to lapse this week gets the same 10% offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per guest, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Keep lapsing members booking with you
cases.text: Per-guest lapse signals from booking gaps, member activity and email response. The right offer, channel and moment for each guest, including a member rate reminder before they book elsewhere.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next stay that fits
cases.text: Next best room, destination and add-on per guest, based on past stays. No more blanket 10% mails to guests who would have booked anyway.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Give members a reason to book again
cases.text: Personal destination, meeting and event nudges by email and on your site, timed to each guest’s booking pattern and not to a calendar.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
